jobs.name: daily-dotfiles-nixos-rebuild
jobs.prompt:
Run the daily NixOS maintenance routine on this VM by triggering the dedicated systemd oneshot, not by running nixos-rebuild directly inside the Hermes service sandbox.

Requirements:
- Use terminal commands only.
- Start and wait for: sudo systemctl start hermes-daily-nixos-rebuild.service
- Do not run nix flake update or nixos-rebuild directly from the cron session; those happen inside the root-owned systemd service.
- If the service fails, collect diagnostics with:
  - sudo systemctl status --no-pager hermes-daily-nixos-rebuild.service
  - sudo journalctl -u hermes-daily-nixos-rebuild.service -n 200 --no-pager
- If the service fails, send an email to berker.zor@gmail.com with:
  - subject: "[Hermes Daily Routine] Nix rebuild failed on $(hostname)"
  - short summary of failed step
  - relevant status/journal output
- If the service succeeds, do not send email.
- Exit with non-zero status when the routine fails.

Rationale:
Hermes cron runs inside hermes-agent.service, which uses ProtectSystem=strict. Even sudo inherits that service mount namespace, so direct nixos-rebuild switch can fail writing /nix/var/nix/profiles with "Read-only file system". Starting the dedicated systemd unit asks PID 1 to run the rebuild outside the Hermes sandbox.

Execute now.

jobs.name: sync-hermes-brain-to-github
jobs.prompt:
Sync Hermes persistent brain files to GitHub.

Use terminal commands only.
Source state: /var/lib/hermes/.hermes
Mirror repo working copy: /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync
Remote: https://github.com/otto-hermes/hermes-brain.git

Policy:
- Prefer a gitignore-style mirror: copy the whole source tree, then exclude only secret/runtime/noisy paths.
- Do not handpick a short include list; safe new docs/reports should become visible in GitHub automatically.
- Never upload secrets or runtime data.

Do:
1) Ensure /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync exists and is a git repo cloned from the remote.
2) Ensure /var/lib/hermes/.hermes/.gitignore exists and excludes at least: .env, config.yaml, auth.json, sessions/, logs/, cron/, platforms/, pastes/, local DB/cache files, *.key, *.pem, *.token, *.lock.
3) Sync source into mirror with rsync using delete mode, no owner/group/perms, protecting .git and excluding .gitignore patterns. Example shape:
   rsync -a --delete --no-owner --no-group --no-perms --filter='P .git/' --exclude='.git/' --exclude-from=/var/lib/hermes/.hermes/.gitignore /var/lib/hermes/.hermes/ /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync/
4) Remove ignored leftovers from the mirror without touching tracked safe files:
   HOME=/home/hermes git -C /home/hermes/hermes-brain-sync clean -fdX
5) Commit only when there are changes (message: "chore: sync brain snapshot").
6) Push to origin main using HOME=/home/hermes so git sees Otto's stored GitHub HTTPS credentials.

If push fails, print concise diagnostics and exit non-zero.
If nothing changed, print "no changes".

jobs.name: sync-dotfiles-to-github
jobs.prompt:
Sync /home/hermes/dotfiles to GitHub repo otto-hermes/dotfiles.

Use terminal only.
Steps:
1) cd /home/hermes/dotfiles
2) Ensure origin is https://github.com/otto-hermes/dotfiles.git
3) git add -A
4) If there are staged changes, commit with message: "chore: automated dotfiles sync"
5) Push branch main to origin
6) If no changes, print "no changes"

On push failure, print concise diagnostics and exit non-zero.
